comment: Post-NAM stereo-linked automatic level compensation. Mode AMP is transparent; Mode NAM enables a lightweight peak-envelope leveler. Place immediately after NAM and before delay/reverb.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: AMP = transparent pass-through; NAM = automatic post-profile level compensation.

params.name: Amount
params.comment: Compensation strength. Maximum reduction is scaled from 0 to 80%; this is a peak-envelope approximation, not precision LUFS matching.
